name: Top Smoke - Zkittlez Pre-Roll Pack
description: ZKittlez is an indica dominant strain made by crossing Grape Ape X Grapefruit. This strain will give you an uplifted head buzz that leaves you euphoric and creatively inspired. This is accompanied by a relaxing body buzz that slowly spreads throughout the body and to your very fingertips, leaving you completely calm and pain free without limiting your movement. 28 one gram pre-rolls.
